title: EXPERIENCE
heading: Experience from projects and programs I've taken part in

items.desc: Built a bilingual portfolio platform with a self-hosted admin panel — Next.js frontend, API backend with authentication and CRUD, SQLite storage, Dockerized and deployed via GitHub Actions — plus a fully static version live at afadfath.net.
Developed an online counseling platform connecting students with counselors: REST API backend with Node.js, Express, Sequelize, and PostgreSQL with Swagger documentation, plus a React frontend.

Machine Learning path of Bangkit — a career readiness program led by Google with GoTo and Traveloka under Indonesia's Kampus Merdeka initiative. Focused on machine learning and data science through an industry-designed curriculum, mentoring, and practical projects.
